pillars.title: The
pillars.subtitle: LinkYourArt unites the major actors of the creative economy and the public in a single, secure, and transparent ecosystem.

creators.title: Creators
creators.desc: The heartbeat of the ecosystem. Creators get their vision certified on the LYA Registry, earning recognition while keeping full control of their work.

investors.title: Patrons
investors.desc: Back the next generation of masterpieces. Patrons support certified projects and receive graduated recognition based on their engagement.

professionals.title: Professionals
professionals.desc: The validators of excellence. Industry leaders, labels, and producers rate projects, ensuring the LYA Score reflects their true creative maturity.

public.title: The Public
public.desc: Discover the projects of tomorrow. The general public can explore the registry, track the creative journey, and support works they believe in.

standard.title: The LYA
standard.desc: LinkYourArt introduces the unique quality certification standard for the creative market. The LYA Score — from 0 to 1000 points — combines algorithmic analysis and expert committee review to provide the only objective, transparent and public measure of creative quality.

p1.title: Creator's Initial Submission
p1.desc: The initial project file submitted by the creator at inception.

p2.title: LYA Algorithm Index
p2.desc: Real-time data analysis across 5 critical pillars of project health.

p3.title: Professional Validation
p3.desc: Expert ratings from industry leaders (Netflix, Amazon, Producers).

scoring.title: The LYA
scoring.subtitle: Our proprietary algorithm evaluates every project across 5 official pillars, providing a transparent and objective LYA Score out of 1000.

c1.label: IC · Conceptual Integrity
c1.desc: Coherence and clarity of the creative vision: does the project deliver on its artistic promise end to end?

c2.label: MA · Current Maturity
c2.desc: The project's real progress: what is already produced, documented, and verifiable today.

c3.label: CE · Evolution Capacity
c3.desc: The project's room to grow: its capacity to reach new certification milestones.

c4.label: FR · Real Feasibility
c4.desc: Soundness of the execution plan: resources, timeline, and means in place to see it through.

c5.label: IN · Embodiment
c5.desc: The creator's presence and credibility: their direct, verifiable involvement in the project.

cta.title: Start
cta.desc: Join the professional creative registry and start certifying or supporting projects today.

quotes.scoring: The LYA Score is the most reliable measure of a creative project's maturity, updated at every verified milestone and periodic professional audit.

footer.disclaimer: LinkYourArt Protocol operates as a technological layer for creative certification. Not a financial service.
